description: Set the status of a ToDo card (open | done | dismissed). A project token may only close an `open` card, as `done` (carried out, with or without a resulting specification) or `dismissed` (closed without being carried out); reopening a card and moving it between `done` and `dismissed` are refused with 403. Repeating the closed status a card already has succeeds unchanged. A 403 can also mean that no such card exists.

status.description: New status; a project token may only set done or dismissed, on an open card.

name: todos_set_status
title: Set ToDo card status
